nodes.description: A single heterozygous missense or in-frame variant alters a conserved residue in spectrin repeat 6 of the desmoplakin plakin domain, the N-terminal region that binds plakoglobin and the plakophilins. Structural modelling and the recurrent introduction of helix-breaking proline residues suggest that the variants destabilize the repeat. Whether the mutant protein acts through insufficient recruitment of desmoplakin to desmosomes or through a dominant-negative effect on other desmosomal proteins has not been tested.
